preconditions.description: The number of nodes n must be between 1 and 200000.
The number of queries m must be between 1 and 200000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= 1000 for a_i in a)
preconditions.description: Each initial value a_i of the nodes must be between 1 and 1000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= v_i <= n and 1 <= u_i <= n for v_i, u_i in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge must connect valid nodes within the range of 1 to n.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= n and 1 <= val <= 1000 for query in queries if query[0] == 1)
preconditions.description: For type 1 queries, x must be a valid node and val must be between 1 and 1000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= n for query in queries if query[0] == 2)
preconditions.description: For type 2 queries, x must be a valid node.

postconditions.description: The output must contain the values of the queried nodes in the order of the queries.
